description: Reads the brand's homepage and drafts ten prompts and up to six competitors. Nothing is saved to the brand: show the draft to the user, then add each competitor they confirm with shruwd_add_competitor, passing its aliases and contextTerms from the draft, and after that the prompts they keep, in one shruwd_add_prompts call. Returns the stored draft when one exists unless regenerate is true. Three drafts per brand per day; a new draft can take up to a minute.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

regenerate.description: Replace the stored draft with a new one.

name: shruwd_suggest_setup
title: Suggest prompts and competitors
